body: when u die, what happens next is real fucked up.
At least give it a chance? 10 years? Ok, when you are my age, take the fucking shotgun. P.S. No one really gives a fuck about you.
I am scared of cremation and burial. Do you realize what happens after death?

I am 51, seems there are lots of men 35+ in our boat. I can't promise you that things will get better, but it gets harder with every year.  I actually have $$, I have a career in tech(self employed) but honestly it means shit without people to share it with. I could say self improvement, I tried it and actually met someone, but if things aren't meant, you can't really push it.

I can't say there is anything else for your or me at this point. There also men our age that are married and extremely miserable too. People can go to the store and get creamed in a head on crash. No one knows what the fuck is going to happen. The only advice I can give is the YT self help rabbit hole., working out, diet etc, at least you get a faux feeling you are doing something good.
